_meta.description: 400+ verified cultural, behavioral and socioeconomic data points for Sweden. Covers daily routines (FIKA culture!), spending, social norms (Janteloven, high trust, 55% non-religious), business culture (480 days parental leave total, 65%+ union density), religion, digital behavior (Spotify origin, Swish, BankID 95%+), education (free university, school at 7!), housing, food & lifestyle, trust & governance (CPI #3), and regional variations (Stockholm vs regions).
